summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Extraordinary General Meeting held November 2, 2026, at which shareholders approved a ten-for-one share consolidation of both class A and class B ordinary shares (par value rising from US$0.00000125 to US$0.0000125), plus adoption of a fifth amended and restated memorandum and articles. Fractional entitlements round up to the next whole share; authorised capital becomes US$50,000 across 3.6 billion class A and 400 million class B shares. This is a routine capital-structure housekeeping matter, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or premiums apply. Watch for effective-date trading mechanics and any post-consolidation liquidity effects.
